title: Russian tanker nears blockaded Cuba, Trump shrugs off ‘a boat of oil’
summary: A ​Russian oil tanker entered Cuban waters on Monday despite a de facto US fuel blockade as President Donald Trump has turned up the political pressure on ‌the Caribbean island in recent days.
